description: Runs one of the tools not listed here by name: run_tool(name, arguments). Each tool's full definition - every argument and the answer's shape - is the resource alion://tools/<name>; calling a tool with no arguments answers a working example. The tools: get_index(index, slice, period) - Alion data indices; get_company_money(company, kind, direction, since) - Money in and out of a company; get_company_ownership(company) - Owners and structure of a company; get_company_record(company) - Public record of a company (counterparty check); search_contracts(company, buyer, ending_within, country) - Public contracts and tenders; find_suppliers(need, category, country, for_company) - Find suppliers with evidence; compare_suppliers(companies) - Compare suppliers side by side; match_people(job_id, job_url, vacancy, title) - Match people to a vacancy; similar_people(person, country) - Find people like one person; get_person(person) - Read a person's profile; check_fit(person, offer) - Check an offer against a person's filters; send_message(person, purpose, job, on_behalf_of) - Write to a person; get_conversation(conversation_id, message_id, since_message) - Read a conversation; list_conversations(since) - List your conversations; agent_status() - Your agent on Alion; verify_company(domain) - Verify the company you hire for; set_webhook(url) - Get answers by webhook; list_orders(order_id, status) - List your job orders; get_shortlist(order_id, stage, source) - Read the shortlist of an order; add_to_shortlist(order_id, person) - Add a person to an order; move_on_shortlist(order_id, person, stage, remove) - Move a person on a shortlist; list_watches() - List this agent's watches; delete_watch(watch_id) - Delete a watch; my_matches(feed, apply_ready, country, city) - My job matches; get_apply_kit(job_id, url) - Prepare an application for the person; save_answers(answers) - Save the person's answers for application forms; log_application(job_id, status, reason, missed_fields) - Record what came of an application; draft_profile_change(kind, value, reason) - Draft a change to my profile; check_counterparty(target) - Check a counterparty; register_agent(name, description, principal, company_domain) - Register your agent; get_agent(agent) - Look up an agent; contact_company(company, purpose, subject, message) - Write to a company; company_inbox_settings(company, purposes, day_cap) - Set what your company takes from agents; report_problem(kind, text, tool, arguments) - Report a problem with Alion; check_employer(company, job, message, refresh) - Check an employer before applying.

arguments.description: That tool's arguments, as its definition names them.

name: run_tool
title: Run any other Alion tool
